tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: The ground before the accent is mixed in. Paint with --surface (3% accent over this), never with this directly.

tokens.name: hover-base
tokens.usage: Hover and field ground before the accent is mixed in. Paint with --surface-hover (6% accent over this).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Glass of menus, sheets, hover text and job cards, over a 24px blur. Use through --glass, which the calm mood makes solid.

tokens.name: overlay-solid
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces with no glass: the calm mood and reduced transparency. Use through --glass.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines of panels, fields and cards. Below 3:1 on purpose, so it never marks a state on its own; more contrast swaps it for border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be seen: checkbox and radio outlines, and every border when the system asks for more contrast. 3:1 on surface and overlay-solid.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and titles on surface, surface-hover, surface-selected and glass.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Second lines, headings of groups, placeholders, resting icons. On surface, surface-hover and overlay-solid. On surface-selected use text instead (4.4:1 there).

tokens.name: accent-start
tokens.usage: First of the three close accent colours. Gradient lines only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus rings, the selected edge, live icons, carets. A mark, not text: for words use --accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-end
tokens.usage: Last of the three accent colours. Gradient lines only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Ticks, knobs and labels on --accent-fill. Dark on the light accent of the dark theme.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill and border of what deletes or failed. White reads on it. As text use danger-ink. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Words that say something failed or will be deleted, on surface and surface-hover.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Fill of a finished bar. Never text, and always with a word.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Words that say something worked, on surface and surface-selected.

tokens.name: fresh
tokens.usage: What changed today: a new date or a new number, on surface. Older values cool down to text-muted.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb under the pointer.

tokens.name: ocean-start
tokens.usage: data-accent="ocean". Blue to green. The default pick for business apps. Becomes accent-start; never used directly.

tokens.name: ocean
tokens.usage: data-accent="ocean". Blue to green. The default pick for business apps. Becomes accent; never used directly.

tokens.name: ocean-end
tokens.usage: data-accent="ocean". Blue to green. The default pick for business apps. Becomes accent-end; never used directly.

tokens.name: forest-start
tokens.usage: data-accent="forest". Green to gold. Becomes accent-start; never used directly.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: data-accent="forest". Green to gold. Becomes accent; never used directly.

tokens.name: forest-end
tokens.usage: data-accent="forest". Green to gold. Becomes accent-end; never used directly.

tokens.name: ember-start
tokens.usage: data-accent="ember". Orange to pink. Keep danger apart from it with a word. Becomes accent-start; never used directly.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: data-accent="ember". Orange to pink. Keep danger apart from it with a word. Becomes accent; never used directly.

tokens.name: ember-end
tokens.usage: data-accent="ember". Orange to pink. Keep danger apart from it with a word. Becomes accent-end; never used directly.

tokens.name: rose-start
tokens.usage: data-accent="rose". Pink to violet. Becomes accent-start; never used directly.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: data-accent="rose". Pink to violet. Becomes accent; never used directly.

tokens.name: rose-end
tokens.usage: data-accent="rose". Pink to violet. Becomes accent-end; never used directly.

tokens.name: mono-start
tokens.usage: data-accent="mono". No hue, for the most formal apps and for apps whose content is colourful. Becomes accent-start; never used directly.

tokens.name: mono
tokens.usage: data-accent="mono". No hue, for the most formal apps and for apps whose content is colourful. Becomes accent; never used directly.

tokens.name: mono-end
tokens.usage: data-accent="mono". No hue, for the most formal apps and for apps whose content is colourful. Becomes accent-end; never used directly.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The name of a page or a settings section.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: The name of a sheet, and the app's own name.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything else. One size carries the app.
styles.sample: Everything you reach for is one key away.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The one name in a row or card that matters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The second line under a name, notes, the status pill.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Headings inside a palette or menu.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between chips, inside menus, between panels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its word; padding of rows and fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of cards, buttons and job cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of sheets and pages; between groups.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons, fields, tabs, hover text.

tokens.name: radius-large
tokens.usage: Panels, menus, sheets, cards, job cards. Chips and bars are full pills (999px).

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The one shadow, only on what floats: menus, sheets, palettes, job cards, hover text.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons and fields. 36px for roomy apps or touch; change it in one place.

tokens.name: title-bar
tokens.usage: Title bar and tab strip.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The sidebar folded to icons. Open it is 220px.
